programs.title: A Wild Year
programs.desc: In the north east of England lies a wild and remote moorland. This ancient landscape of heather-clad uplands and sheltered dales is home to red grouse and tough moorland sheep.

programs.title: Romeo and Juliet with Rudolf Nureyev and Margot Fonteyn
programs.desc: Margot Fonteyn and Rudolf Nureyev star in the Royal Ballet's Romeo and Juliet. From 1977.

programs.title: The Magic of Dance with Margot Fonteyn
programs.desc: Margot Fonteyn looks at the work of some of the greatest of the pioneers, from the Commedia dell'Arte in 17th-century Italy to Martha Graham in 20th-century America.

programs.title: Margot Fonteyn
programs.desc: A tribute to Dame Margot Fonteyn, first broadcast shortly after her death in 1991. Featuring interviews with colleagues and friends and extracts from her ballets.

programs.title: Rudolf Nureyev: Living Famously
programs.desc: A profile of Rudolf Nureyev, whose electrifying performances and enigmatic personality made him ballet's first major star. First broadcast in 2003.

programs.title: The Classical Collection
programs.desc: A celebration of the newly recognised glories of classical music, including a wealth of works written by largely forgotten or neglected composers.
